bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Never work beneath a vehicle supported only by a hydraulic floor jack, always lower the frame onto ANSI/ASME-rated steel jack stands.
core_mechanism_bullets: Never work beneath a vehicle supported only by a hydraulic floor jack, always lower the frame onto ANSI/ASME-rated steel jack stands.
Disconnect the negative 12-volt battery terminal first and reconnect it last so a wrench touching chassis ground cannot short-circuit.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Before raising the front axle on level concrete, a technician sets the parking brake, chocks both rear tires, and positions jack stands under factory pinch welds.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Locate the factory jacking points, VIN plate, and fuse box diagram in a vehicle owner's manual and demonstrate proper wheel-chock placement.

12.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Inflate cold tires to the vehicle manufacturer's B-pillar door-jamb placard PSI, never to the maximum sidewall pressure molded on the tire.
core_mechanism_bullets: Inflate cold tires to the vehicle manufacturer's B-pillar door-jamb placard PSI, never to the maximum sidewall pressure molded on the tire.
Minimum legal tire tread depth is 2/32 of an inch (measured by Lincoln's head on an inverted penny), with 4/32 inch recommended for wet braking.
12.worked_field_example: Tightening lug nuts in a 5-lug star pattern with a calibrated torque wrench to 95 foot-pounds prevents brake rotor warping and stud stretching.
12.counselor_tabletop_demo: Measure cold tire PSI with a gauge, check tread depth in 3 grooves using a 32nds gauge and penny, and decode a P215/65R16 95H DOT sidewall code.
